question: What bodies of knowledge are to be worshipped in this ritual sequence?
premises: The limbs of the Veda are objects of worship.
Traditional teaching and logic are objects of worship.
All scriptures are also included as objects of worship.
inference: The ritual worship extends beyond deities to include authoritative bodies of knowledge.
plain_english: One should worship the Vedāṅgas, Smṛti, Nyāya, and all the scriptures.
